statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-77310: deserializing java.net.InetAddress in jackson-databind still resolved the host name eagerly, so attacker-supplied input could trigger DNS lookups (SSRF); this completes the fix for CVE-2026-54514. On the 2.18 line jackson-databind 2.0.0 before 2.18.9 is affected and 2.18.9 carries the fix: https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-vvgp-rfg2-7rr6 (fix commit https://github.com/FasterXML/jackson-databind/commit/2fc7bd9057dd051d7dea0e5fcad89822d0fa5ebd, in the jackson-databind-2.18.9 tag and not in 2.18.8). We read the Maven metadata and manifest of every jar, nested jars included, in every published gradle-8 package for Alpine 3.23 in the DHI Alpine repository as listed in its index on 2026-11-28 (16 versions, 8.14.4-r0 to 8.14.8-r0; the aarch64 package of each version has the same index checksum as the x86_64 one, and 8.14.5-r4 is published for x86_64 only). Gradle ships jackson-databind as /usr/share/java/gradle/lib/jackson-databind-<version>.jar, each one byte for byte the Maven Central release of that version, and no other jar in these packages contains jackson-databind classes, relocated or not. Builds 8.14.4-r0 to 8.14.5-r3 ship jackson-databind 2.18.6, 8.14.5-r4 and 8.14.5-r5 ship 2.18.8, 8.14.5-r6 to 8.14.5-r9 ship 2.18.9, 8.14.6-r0 to 8.14.7-r0 ship 2.18.11, and 8.14.8-r0 ships 2.18.12. The range ends at 8.14.5-r6, the first build with jackson-databind 2.18.9 or later.

CVE-2026-77310 (GHSA-vvgp-rfg2-7rr6): jackson-databind still resolves host names through DNS when it deserializes an InetAddress, an incomplete fix for CVE-2026-54514 that allows SSRF-style lookups. jackson-databind 2.0.0 to 2.18.8, 2.19.0 to 2.21.4 and 2.22.0 are affected; it is fixed in 2.18.9, 2.21.5 and 2.22.1 (https://github.com/FasterXML/jackson-databind/security/advisories/GHSA-vvgp-rfg2-7rr6; the jackson-databind release notes list the fix, databind#6058, under 2.18.9, 2.21.5 and 2.22.1). We read every gradle-9 package published for Alpine 3.23 in the DHI Alpine repository as of 2026-11-27: 22 versions, 9.4.0-r0 to 9.9.2-r0. Each aarch64 package has the same index checksum as the x86_64 package of that version (9.6.1-r3 and 9.6.1-r4 are published for x86_64 only), so we read the x86_64 packages, checked each against its index checksum, and read every jar in them, including nested jars, taking each library version from the Maven metadata inside the jar under /usr/share/java/gradle/lib, not from the file name. jackson-core and jackson-databind are 2.18.6 in 9.4.0-r0 to 9.6.1-r3, 2.18.8 in 9.6.1-r4 and 9.6.1-r5, 2.18.9 in 9.6.1-r6, 2.22.0 in 9.7.0-r1 and 9.7.1-r0, 2.22.1 in 9.7.1-r1, 2.22.2 in 9.8.0-r1, 2.22.3 in 9.8.1-r0 to 9.9.1-r0 and 2.22.4 in 9.9.2-r0, and each of these jars is byte for byte the Maven Central release of its version. No other jar in any of these builds holds jackson-databind classes, relocated or not. So 9.4.0-r0 to 9.6.1-r5 (2.18.6 and 2.18.8) and 9.7.0-r1 and 9.7.1-r0 (2.22.0) are affected, and 9.6.1-r6 (2.18.9) and every build from 9.7.1-r1 (2.22.1 and later) are fixed; the range has two spans.

We read every gradle-9 package published for Debian 13 in the DHI Debian repository as of 2026-11-27: 15 versions, 9.6.1-0 to 9.9.2-1, each one architecture-independent package that is the same file for amd64 and arm64. We checked each against its index checksum and read every jar in it, including nested jars, taking each library version from the Maven metadata inside the jar under /usr/share/java/gradle/lib, not from the file name. jackson-core and jackson-databind are 2.18.6 in 9.6.1-0, 2.22.0 in 9.7.0-0, 9.7.1-0 and 9.8.0-0, 2.22.3 in 9.8.1-0 to 9.9.1-2 and 2.22.4 in 9.9.2-0 and 9.9.2-1. The Debian packages repack these jars, so the jar files differ from the Maven Central files, but every jackson class in them has the same CRC-32 as the class in the Maven Central release of that version. No other jar in any of these builds holds jackson-databind classes, relocated or not. 9.6.1-0 (2.18.6) and 9.7.0-0 to 9.8.0-0 (2.22.0) are affected and every later build carries 2.22.3 or 2.22.4, so the range ends at 9.8.1-0.
